newsitem.title: KENYA: Tea prices ease at Kenyan auction.
newsitem.headline: Tea prices ease at Kenyan auction.

text.p: Tea prices fell at the weekly Kenyan export auction on Monday amid reduced demand, traders said.

Brighter BP1s declined by 3-7 U.S cents, while mediums eased two cents. Brightest PF1s shed five cents with coloury mediums down by 2 cents. Brighter PDUSTs lost 2 cents while mediums were irregularly lower by 3 cents. Brighter Dust1s shed 3 cents with mediums discounted by 4 cents.
Fannings were generally easier, as were Dusts.
Pakistan was relatively quiet while Middle East countries lent good support.
